(a) the websites of the 20 organizations in the study are not consistent with the organizations’ overall corporate identities; (b) the websites do not communicate the organizations’ overall identities; (c) the organizations’ identities are communicated through their websites; and (d) the websites communicate the organizations’ corporate identities.

the study of corporate web identity, and in particular with the role of corporate web identity in the communication of organizational messages to stakeholders

the role of websites in the corporate identity communication process.

corporate websites are a key component of an organization’s identity, and are an important communication channel through which organizations seek to influence and manage their corporate identity.
websites are an important component of corporate identity and that they can be used to shape perceptions of an organization, especially in the context of global communication.
